q: What interest subvention does ADEETIE give, and what rate will my factory actually pay?
title: ADEETIE interest subvention rates
short: ADEETIE cuts the interest on an energy efficiency loan by 5 percentage points for micro and small enterprises and 3 points for medium enterprises. The scheme keeps your net rate at 2 percent or more, so a loan already near that floor gets a smaller cut.
audience: MSME owners and finance heads planning an energy efficiency loan

ul: Micro and small enterprises: 5 percent interest subvention on the eligible loan amount.
The net borrowing rate after subvention cannot fall below 2 percent.
Loans of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 15 crore from banks or financial institutions.
Up to 75 percent debt funding of the project cost.
Projects that achieve and keep at least 10 percent energy savings; the subvention is paid each year the saving holds.

p: You pay your lender as usual. The lender files subvention claims with BEE, which disburses through a nodal bank every quarter. Empanelled auditors verify the actual savings first, so a project that slips below 10 percent puts that year's subvention at risk.

example.title: Example (illustrative)
lines: Small unit, Rs 1 crore loan at 10 percent: subvention 5 points, net about 5 percent
Same loan at 6 percent: 5 points would leave 1 percent, so the cut stops at the 2 percent floor (4 points)
example.note: Illustrative rates. Your lender and the scheme rules decide the eligible amount.

senseible: Senseible keeps a dated, fingerprinted record of every electricity bill and fuel invoice before and after the project, which is the evidence trail you need when the yearly 10 percent saving is checked.
